unspecified_choices: Reuse Ouro LoopOPD optimizer and batch as a controlled Huginn adaptation
Full S-step student backpropagation with nonreentrant checkpointing; not BoD last-eight truncation
Native random state on every forward; teacher and student draws are independent
Native whole-prompt adaptive prefill, batch size 1, latest-m4 cache

dynamic_implementation_choices: Keep all JS>tau boundaries; no Top-S cap or shallow-exit fallback
Mean stop BCE over 1..S_t, then response tokens, then responses
Full-prefix recomputation for learned rollout and full-prefix replay to response max(S_t); no approximate missing KV
Huginn new linear exit head starts weight=0,bias=-2; Ouro reuses original gate
First rollout already uses learned stopping; no native-policy warmup
